notes:
Lead source: inbound from Zendesk app marketplace search + demo request on site. Primary contact: Maya Torres (Head of Ops). Use-case summary: reduce agent time by auto-summarizing incoming tickets, auto-fill triage fields (severity, product area), and propose draft replies. Wants structured JSON payload for downstream automation and function/tool calling to update Zendesk ticket fields.

Customer comments / quotes:
- "We need summaries that fit into the existing ticket body and a JSON payload for triage."
- "Latency should be <500ms for draft replies; background summarization can be slower."

Technical / product notes:
- Prefers hosted API (public cloud) for speed and low ops overhead. Minimal appetite for Private at this stage.
- Throughput: expect peak ~10 rps with bursts to 25 for short windows; concurrency target 5-10.
- Latency SLO: 300-500ms for short reply generation (concise drafts), 1-2s acceptable for full summaries.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget-conscious, looking to keep monthly spend < $2k in first 3 months of POC.
- Model feature needs: function/tool-calling for Zendesk updates, structured output enforcement (JSON schema), streaming helpful but not required.
- Data handling: need audit logs and retention controls; will require SSO for admin users.

Procurement / legal:
- Small vendor contract, but legal will do a short review focused on credentials and retention (expected 1 week).

Open questions from customer:
- Exact token pricing breakdown for streaming vs non-streaming use.
- How easy to map Redwood function-calls to Zendesk ticket fields (need example integration).

Stated next steps: provide POC keys, run live Zendesk integration test 2026-03-17, capture metrics (avg latency, percent valid JSON outputs, post-edit rate by agents).
